risks.Risk Description: Risk related to digital security vulnerabilities and threats, with 78% of respondents rating it as high or very high.

Risk Driver.Driver Description: Technology is cited as the common driver behind high cybersecurity risk.

risks.Risk Description: Risk associated with IT systems and operations, identified as one of the top three risks driven by technology.

Risk Driver.Driver Description: Increasing technology complexity contributes significantly to IT risk.

Contextual Variations: Publicly traded organizations rate IT risks lower compared to financial services.

risks.Risk Description: Risk stemming from reliance on external third parties for services, notably IT, which is rated high but audited less frequently.

Risk Driver.Driver Description: Reliance on technology and external IT services drives third-party relationships risk.

Contextual Variations: Risk perceptions vary by organization type, with publicly traded organizations rating this risk lower compared to financial services.

risks.Risk Description: Risk arising from compliance and regulatory requirements not related to internal controls over financial reporting.
Contextual Variations: Publicly traded organizations tend to rate this risk lower than financial services.

risks.Risk Description: Risk related to internal processes and business operations.
Risk associated with shortcomings in the enterprise risk management process and related activities.
Risk of fraudulent activities; nearly 90% of respondents integrate fraud considerations into audits, with about half of CAEs responsible for fraud investigations.
Risk stemming from issues in organizational governance structures and cultural dynamics.
Risk related to financial reporting processes and internal controls over financial reporting, including Sarbanes–Oxley testing and compliance.
Contextual Variations: Privately held organizations implementing SOX exhibit higher allocations to financial reporting compared to those not implementing SOX.

risks.Risk Description: Risk associated with initiatives to reduce costs and expenses, noted to be particularly high in nonprofit organizations.
risks.Trend: Cost/expense reduction allocation has been trending upward since 2020.
Contextual Variations: Nonprofit organizations rate cost/expense reduction risk higher than other sectors.

risks.Risk Description: Risk related to financial areas not covered by internal controls over financial reporting.
Risk associated with sustainability and non-financial reporting obligations, seen as moderate to high by a significant portion of organizations.
risks.Trend: Audit plans have shown an increased allocation to sustainability/non-financial reporting since 2019.
Contextual Variations: Over 60% of respondents at publicly traded organizations consider this risk moderate to high, while 52% of public sector respondents rate it similarly.

risks.Risk Description: Risk related to the adequacy of support provided for external audit processes, with audit frequencies higher than the perceived risk levels.
